title: COME TO JESUS HE WILL SAVE YOU
stanzas: Eden R. Latta & John H. Tenney
Come to Jesus, He will save you, Though your sins as crimson glow, If you give your heart to Jesus, He will make it white as snow.
Come to Jesus do not tarry, Enter in at mercy's gate, O delay not till the morrow, Lest Thy coming be too late.
Come to Jesus, dying sinner, Other Savior there is none, He will share with you His glory, When your pilgrimage is done.
chorus: Come to Jesus! Come to Jesus! Come to Jesus! come today! Come to Jesus! Come to Jesus! Come to Jesus! come, come today!
